migration_purpose: Consolidate canonical Ticketing authority into JCSchoeman96/ticketing

branch_reconciliation.decision: Use the latest merged authority branch for canonical semantics and the newer main commit only for repository governance. No contract bodies were merged or rewritten during import.

authority_t0_hardening.history: First-parent history includes planning refresh PR #31 and accepted IAM-1 closure PR #32.

planning_t0_post_release_refresh_resume.relationship: Ancestor of the selected semantic authority commit

authority_t0_successor_release.relationship: Earlier accepted release branch included in the hardening branch history

AGENTS.md.rationale: Adapted current authority governance from governance_source_commit for the authority/ subtree.

README.md.rationale: Adapted release and validation instructions to the monorepo paths.

.gitattributes.rationale: Copied source text and binary handling to the monorepo root.

.gitignore.rationale: Merged authority staging and Python cache ignores into the monorepo root rules.

.github.rationale: Moved authority checks into a root GitHub Actions workflow.

contracts/.rationale: Contains installed canonical ZIPs, extracted artifacts, CANON, and manifest.

planning/.rationale: Contains the active ROADMAP and tracer.

release-src/.rationale: Required to validate and construct future successor releases.

tools/.rationale: Required to validate, reconcile, and author releases; Git-root handling was ported for the nested authority directory.

tests/.rationale: Required to preserve authority release and reconciliation coverage; nested-root tests were added.

requirements-release.txt.rationale: Retains the exact release-tool dependency set.

authority-staging/.rationale: Current T0 authority test gates consume these transition candidate files as fixtures. They are retained byte-for-byte for validation only and do not select or define installed authority.

reports/.rationale: Historical cleanup and quarantine reports are not required to validate or author current authority.

.staging/.rationale: Local ignored raw-material scratch data, absent from the selected source Git tree.

.venv/ and .pytest_cache/.rationale: Local runtime and test-cache data, absent from the selected source Git tree.

import_time_equivalence.method: Compared source and imported file sets and bytes immediately after copy, before monorepo path adaptations and documentation edits.
